title: First Time in Drag
overview: Rico, a non-binary person, has built in her home her fortress, welcomed by the love of her mother and her friends Andrea and Sara. The dream of doing drag has been with her for a long time, even though the future scares her. She decides to show herself to her small town near Rome for the first time in drag. She prepares everything with extreme care, but something goes wrong. Yet, right there, she discovers a deeper victory: be herself.
